description: Machine-readable definition of the dcc-mcp Python adapter contract: the rules a repository that publishes a dcc-mcp-* Python package has to satisfy. Consumed by scripts/check_repo_contract.py through --contract and by the vx-repo-contract skill, so a criterion is never written down twice. It is a sibling of contract/repo_contract.json, not a replacement: repo_contract.json covers every repository in the org, this file only covers the Python adapters.

profiles.baseline: Rules every adapter satisfies today. Empty while the families are being built out; adopting repositories start here and ratchet up.
profiles.strict: Every adapter rule. Rules still being rolled out report as warnings, so a repository can adopt the gate before it is clean; promote them with --error-rule or fail the job on warnings with --fail-on warning.

rules.name: ruff-line-length
rules.title: [tool.ruff] line-length is the org baseline
rules.summary: The declared line-length must equal ruff_line_length. A repository without any ruff configuration is reported by A021, not here.

rules.name: ruff-config-present
rules.title: The repository configures ruff
rules.summary: A standalone ruff.toml or a [tool.ruff] section in pyproject.toml must exist. Without it ruff runs on its own defaults and the lint settings differ per developer.

rules.name: pre-commit-present
rules.title: A pre-commit configuration runs the checks locally
rules.summary: One of pre_commit_config_names must exist. It is the premise for enforcing any convention locally: without a hook the contract is only enforced in CI.

rules.name: requires-python-declared
rules.title: pyproject.toml declares requires-python
rules.summary: requires-python must be present in one of requires_python_tables. This rule checks that it is declared, not what it says: the org Python 3.7 red line (PIP-2519) runs to 2026-12-31, so the value itself stays a per-host decision until then.

rules.name: release-please-present
rules.title: release-please config and manifest exist
rules.summary: Every file in release_please_files must exist. release-please is how the org versions and publishes, so a repository without it releases by hand.
